# Quant Julia Module 1, Lesson 2

## Getting started with Julia: Introductory Examples

Installing more packages

```{julia}
using Pkg; 
pkgs = ["Distributions", "ForwardDiff", "LaTeXStrings", "NLsolve", "Plots", "StaticArrays"]

all(haskey.(Ref(Pkg.project(). dependencies), pkgs)) || Pkg.add(pkg)

using LinearAlgebra, Statistics, Plots, LaTeXStrings
using Distributions, ForwardDiff NLsolve, StaticArrays
```
